name: AutomationDirect ZP-MC06B-2-SCVPM connector housing
summary: ZP-MC06B-2-SCVPM connector housing arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: ZP-MC06B-2-SCVPM is the drawing identifier for connector housing in AutomationDirect's ZIPport Multi-Wire Connectors collection. A connector housing supports and protects the selected connector assembly at its mounting interface. Its opening, fastenings and mating approach must be coordinated with the selected insert and hood.

For example, in a removable field-wiring connector on an enclosure wall, use the ZP-MC06B-2-SCVPM reference to coordinate panel mounting, insert position and mating hood approach. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Enclosures and Wiring/ZIPport Multi-Wire Connectors/ZP-MC06B-2-SCVPM.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep panel mounting, insert position and mating hood approach visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named ZP-MC06B-2-SCVPM drawing and its connector housing role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
